name: Artisan Slider for Elementor
author: Arth Patel

sections.description:
Artisan Slider Elementor Widget is a simple yet powerful circular thumbnail slider built for Elementor.
It features smooth transitions, autoplay options, and custom styling to match your site perfectly.

Features:

  • Circular thumbnail navigation
  • Fully responsive and lightweight
  • Easy to customize via Elementor settings
  • Autoplay and manual navigation support
  • Control the visible arc of thumbnails
  • Choose the active thumbnail position
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/artisan-slider directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the new Artisan Slider widget inside Elementor to create beautiful sliders.
sections.faq:
Does it work only with Elementor?

Yes, this plugin requires Elementor to work.

Can I control the number of thumbnails?

Yes, you can adjust thumbnails and settings easily from the widget controls.

Can I control the thumbnail to show only in half part of circle?

Yes, and you can show thumbnails in any particular part of the circle using the “Starting Angle” and “Arc Length” options.

Can I control the active thumbnail?

Yes, there are three options for the active thumbnail — First, Middle, and Last. You can select one using the “Active Index Position in Arc” dropdown.
